d.summary: The Jaguar F-Pace has 1 Diesel Engine and 1 Petrol Engine on offer. The Diesel engine is 1997 cc while the Petrol engine is 1997 cc .  It is available with Automatic transmission.Depending upon the variant and fuel type the F-Pace has a mileage of 8.1 to 10.2 kmpl. The F-Pace is a 5 seater 4 cylinder car  and has length of 4747 mm, width of 2175 mm and a wheelbase of 2445 mm.
